configuration.query: Show names, accounts and contacts (name, phone) of opportunities containing terms like printer and electronics
configuration.rephrase: The query will join opportunity, account and contact tables, get the Opportunity name, Account name, Contact fullName, Contact telephone1, Contact address1_telephone1 where the opportunity name contain the terms 'printer' or 'electronics'
configuration.standardsql: SELECT [Opportunity].[name] AS [opportunityName], [Account].[name] AS [accountName], [Contact].[fullName] AS [contactName], [Contact].[address1_telephone1] AS [contactMainPhone], [Contact].[telephone1] AS [contactBussinessPhone] FROM [Opportunity] JOIN [Account] ON [Opportunity].[parentAccountId] = [Account].[accountId] JOIN [Contact] ON [Opportunity].[parentContactId] = [Contact].[contactId] WHERE [Opportunity].[name] LIKE '%printer%' OR [Opportunity].[name] LIKE '%electronics%'
